question: which shops in Trivandrum have the worst ratings?
golden_sql: SELECT sd.name, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM shop_details sd JOIN reviews r ON r.shop_id = sd.id JOIN shop_address sa ON sa.shop_id = sd.id WHERE sa.is_default = 1 AND sa.city IN ('Trivandrum', 'Thiruvananthapuram') AND sd.status = 1 GROUP BY sd.id, sd.name ORDER BY avg_rating ASC LIMIT 5;
